purpose: Recorded fixture single-value normalization cross-check; not a global electrical calibration
coefficient_method: k = 10000 ohm / arithmetic_mean(all eligible recorded S1D1 ohms)
eligibility: Complete original RES frame with valid CRC, header/trailer/config identity and structure; point expected, acquired, fresh, valid, positive numeric value and no error
paired_ratio: S8D8/S1D1 from the same eligible recorded frame, diagnostic only; it is not a per-frame replacement calibration coefficient
distribution: Observed min/max, arithmetic mean, linearly interpolated P05/P95 at (n-1)*q, population standard deviation; not confidence or accuracy bounds
